mcat_description.short: Prefabricated concrete houses are factory-manufactured RCC (Reinforced Cement Concrete) panel-based dwelling structures — including full houses, single rooms, and labour quarters — that are assembled on-site from precast wall, floor, and roof components.
mcat_description.long: A prefabricated concrete house is a residential or semi-residential structure built using precast RCC panels and components manufactured under controlled factory conditions and then transported to site for rapid assembly. The dominant commercial form in India is the precast RCC panel house or room unit, where wall panels, roof slabs, and structural columns are cast in M30–M50 grade concrete conforming to IS 15916 and IS 456, then bolted or grouted together on-site. These structures are used for permanent rural housing, government housing schemes (PMAY), labour quarters at industrial sites, site offices, and low-cost residential construction. Key advantages over conventional brick-mortar construction include faster erection time, consistent concrete quality, reduced on-site skilled labour dependency, and suitability for repetitive/large-scale housing projects.

market_context: In India, prefabricated concrete houses are commercially known as 'precast houses' or 'RCC precast houses' — the term 'precast' dominates buyer vocabulary over 'prefabricated' in search behaviour. The dominant construction system uses factory-cast RCC wall panels, roof slabs, and columns assembled on-site, governed by IS 15916 (Building Design and Erection Using Prefabricated Concrete) and IS 456 (Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice). Concrete grades used in Indian precast housing typically range from M30 to M50, with IS 15916 specifying dimensional tolerances of ±5 mm for factory-produced elements versus ±10 mm for in-situ construction. The Building Materials and Technology Promotion Council (BMTPC) and the Indian Concrete Institute (ICI) have published additional guidelines for precast construction in India. Demand is driven by government affordable housing schemes (PMAY), industrial labour accommodation, and rural housing — with Bangalore, Surat, Pune, Delhi-NCR, and Hyderabad being active manufacturing and supply hubs. The market distinguishes between full house units, single-room/labour quarter units, and panel-only supply; buyers in the B2B segment are predominantly contractors, housing agencies, and industrial project owners. A BIS committee (CED 32) is currently developing a unified code for precast construction in India, indicating the regulatory framework is still maturing.

research_strategy_consumed.reason: Prefabricated concrete houses are engineered construction products evaluated on structural specs (concrete grade, reinforcement, load capacity), compliance with BIS standards (IS:1343, IS:456), and local building codes — not brand dominance. Agent 3 should prioritise BIS/NRMCA standards, concrete technical datasheets, and structural design references.
